metadata.title: Key Management Platform SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing the institutional Key Management Platform, establishing authoritative cryptographic key lifecycle management and eliminating unmanaged or ad-hoc key material.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Key Management Platform provides centralized, governed lifecycle management for all institutional cryptographic keys, ensuring strong protection, controlled use, auditable rotation, and defensible destruction.

props.name: platform-role
props.remarks: Key Management is a Tier-1 institutional platform required for all encryption, signing, and cryptographic trust operations.

props.name: implements-pattern
props.remarks: This SSPP is the authoritative implementation and assurance anchor for the Key Management security pattern.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Key usage and administration rely on Secure Identity for strong authentication and role separation.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Key services rely on Secure Network for protected communication, segmentation, and monitoring.

props.name: cryptographic-compliance
props.remarks: All cryptographic modules, libraries, and hardware used for key generation, storage, and cryptographic operations must be FIPS 140-3 validated.

props.name: key-storage-model
props.remarks: Cryptographic keys must be protected using hardware-backed mechanisms such as HSMs or TPMs; file-based or software-only key storage is prohibited.

props.name: endpoint-key-protection
props.remarks: Keys on endpoints and servers must be generated and protected using TPM-backed mechanisms where available.

props.name: shared-key-protection
props.remarks: Keys used for shared services, signing authorities, or sensitive data protection must be generated and stored in HSM-backed key stores.

props.name: prohibited-key-practices
props.remarks: Storage or distribution of unprotected private keys in files (e.g., .pem, .pfx, .key) is explicitly prohibited.

props.name: cryptographic-agility
props.remarks: Key management must support controlled algorithm transition and revocation without application redesign.

system-implementation.remarks: The Key Management Platform enforces centralized generation, protection, usage control, rotation, and destruction of cryptographic keys across institutional systems.

roles.title: Key Custodian
roles.remarks: Manages cryptographic key lifecycle operations, including generation, rotation, and destruction.

roles.title: Cryptography Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Defines approved cryptographic algorithms, key sizes, lifecycles, and storage models.

roles.title: Key Management Operations
roles.remarks: Operates HSMs, TPM integration, and key management services.

control-implementation.remarks: All cryptographic key lifecycle controls are enforced by the Key Management Platform and inherited by applications. Applications are prohibited from generating, storing, or managing cryptographic keys outside this platform.
